column1: # Hand-labelled ground truth for filename dating.
# Provenance: the published resource filenames of MIT 6.006 "Introduction to
# Algorithms", Spring 2020, on MIT OpenCourseWare, fetched 2026-08-11 from
# not written for this test, which is the only reason a number measured on them
# means anything -- a corpus invented alongside the parser measures whether the
# author thought of a case, not whether the parser works.
# Each line is `filename<TAB>kind:ordinal`, or `-` for a file that carries no
# ordinal at all. The label is read off the filename's own semantics (`_lec18`
# is lecture 18); it is not a statement about what the parser ought to return.
# These filenames carry NO dates -- only ordinals. So this set measures ordinal
# extraction against three decoy numbers per name (`6`, `006`, `20`), and says
# nothing about whether the interpolated dates are right. See ROADMAP, Phase 3.
